additional_info.subject: ID0423210-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001120 Mainbreaker_QA1 CRM:00315002612
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi,
After our site visit today we were able to bring the charger online and working.
We tested the whole circuit of QA28 and QA29, nothing wrong.
We had a strange topic where we would try to measure the circuit and the FC14-17 would trip and we replaced QA28 thinking it could have a short circuit but please be aware that it's possible that the QA28 was good. I didn't confirm with Yigit and Mert about that, so please check if the device is good in another charger.
After checking all the circuits regarding the MA1, QA1 and UVR, there was no clear answer besides that either MA1 or QA1 was faulty. When we replaced the MA1, the charger was working again.
Since it's resolved I will close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
